newsitem.title: USA: Palo Verde 1,221 MW nuclear unit back to 100 pct.
newsitem.headline: Palo Verde 1,221 MW nuclear unit back to 100 pct.

text.p: The 1,221 megawatt (MW) Palo Verde 3 nuclear unit near Phoenix, Ariz., was back to 100 percent capacity after operations were trimmed by 10 percent for a day of repair work, a spokesman for the plant said Thursday.
The work was related to a water leak in a small pump within the unit's secondary system, the spokesman for Arizona Public Service Co said.
Palo Verde's other two 1,221 MW units were said to be operating normally.
Arizona Public Service Co, a subsidiary of Pinnacle West Capital Corp, is the majority owner and operator of the Palo Verde plant.
